questions.questionHtml:

A. She hugged my mom and almost screamed when she saw me.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BCAD'.

Key Points While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some grammatical or contextual connections between them. Also, the first sentence of a passage is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 

  • Sentence B is the independent sentence and simply talks about a long ride which took the subjects (we) to their final destination. 
  • So, sentence B is the first sentence after rearrangement. 
  • Sentence C describes who(a woman) greeted the subjects when they finally reached. Hence, C follows B.
  • Sentence A which explains how the woman greeted the subjects should come after sentence C, to maintain continuity on the topic. 
  • Sentence D is the concluding statement of the passage as it provides further information regarding the author's thoughts about the woman who greeted them. .

Thus, the correct order after rearrangement is option 3 i.e. BCAD.

So, the correct paragraph is : (B) It was a long ride before we finally reached. (C) A plump, over excited woman greeted us at the door. (A) She hugged my mom and almost screamed when she saw me. (D) Apparently, she had seen me as a baby and behaved as if she didn’t expect me to grow up!

questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. My father is the only breadwinner in the family.
B. My mother happily lends a helping hand in his hard work.
C. I belong to a family where it is difficult to make both ends meet.
D. He earns a rather meager amount, working as a mason.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'CADB.'

Key Points

  • The sentence 'C' is independent of any other sentence as it is introducing or giving general information about "someone who has little money ". Hence, 'C' is the first part.
  • Sentence A will come after C as it is giving information about the only person who earns money i.e. his father.
  • Sentence D will come after A as it is further giving information about the job of the father i.e. what he actually does to earn money.
  • Sentence 'B' concludes by giving information about the mother who helps her husband in his work.
     

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences: I belong to a family where it is difficult to make both ends meet. My father is the only breadwinner in the family. He earns a rather meager amount, working as a mason. My mother happily lends a helping hand in his hard work. 

Hint

  • Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:
    • Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
    • Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
    • Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

Key Points

  • In the underlined segment of the given sentence, the use of the simple past tense ''not ran out'' is incorrect.

  • The third conditional sentence format: past perfect, modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.)​ + have + past participle.

  • Therefore, the past perfect ''had not run out'' should be used in place of the simple past tense ''not ran out''.

questions.question: Directions: Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'. It is the true fact that the second wave of Covid-19 that has gripped India is more deadly.

It is the true fact that the second wave of Covid-19 that has gripped India is more deadly.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'A fact.'

Key Points

  • In the underlined segment, the use of the article 'the' is incorrect and the use of the adjective ''true'' is superfluous or not required.
  • The definite article 'the' is used before singular and plural nouns when the noun is specific or particular.
  • Therefore, an indefinite article is needed in place of the definite article 'the'.
  • 'A' and 'an' are indefinite articles, which means that they refer to, or introduce, an unspecified noun.
    • We use ''a'' before a consonant sound (here, fact) and we use ''an'' before a vowel sound.
  • Also, the noun 'Fact' means A thing that is known or proved to be true.
  • Therefore, the adjective ''true'' or its synonyms like ''real, correct'' are superfluous before the noun 'fact'.
     

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct Sentence: It is a fact that the second wave of Covid-19 that has gripped India is more deadly.

    • The subject of the given sentence is 'I'. 
    • The object of the given sentence is 'His laptop'. 
    • Since modal verb has been used in the active voice, therefore, the passive voice will follow the given structure:

      • Passive Voice - modal verb(can) + be + V3 
    • Here, 'could not use' will be changed into 'could not be used' because in 'active to passive' transformation third form of the verb is used.

Hinglish

    • दिए गए वाक्य का subject 'I' है।
    • दिए गए वाक्य का object 'His laptop' है।
    • चूँकि सक्रिय स्वर में मोडल क्रिया का प्रयोग किया गया है, इसलिए निष्क्रिय स्वर दिए गए ढांचे का पालन करेगा:
      • Active Voice - modal verb(can) + V1 
      • Passive Voice - modal verb(can) + be + V3
  • यहाँ, 'could not use' को 'could not be used' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि 'active to passive' परिवर्तन में verb के third form का उपयोग किया जाता है।

questions.questionHtml:

questions.solution:

Key Points

  • The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
  • We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.

    • Sentence D will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence.
    • Sentence C will be the next sentence.
    • Lastly, Sentence B will be used.
    • Thus, the correct sequence:
      • A: There are several factors that contribute to wisdom.​
      • D: Of these, I should put first a sense of proportion.
      • C: This is the capacity to take account of all important factors in a problem and to attach to each its due weight.
      • B: Doing this has become more difficult than before owing to the complexity of the specialised knowledge required.
         

Correct Sequence: There are several factors that contribute to wisdom.​ Of these, I should put first a sense of proportion. This is the capacity to take account of all important factors in a problem and to attach to each its due weight. Doing this has become more difficult than before owing to the complexity of the specialised knowledge required.

    • Example: Her consistent bad behavior put Mukul to a lot of trouble.

Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

questions.solution:
​The correct answer is 'Autobiographies are written by people for various reasons'.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
  • The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
    • Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
    • Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) 
  • Example:
    • Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) 
    • English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)
  • The subject of the given sentence is 'People'. 
  • The object of the given sentence is 'Autobiographies'. 
  • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
  • 'write' will be changed into 'are written'.
     

Correct Sentence: Autobiographies are written by people for various reasons.

Hinglish

  •  दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है।
  • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
    • Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
    • Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) 
  • Example:
    • Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) 
    • English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)
  • दिए गए वाक्य का Subject 'People' है और दिए गए वाक्य का object 'Autobiographies' है।
  • वस्तु के स्थान पर विषय रखा जाएगा और विषय के स्थान पर वस्तु रखी जाएगी।
  • और 'write' को 'are written' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
  • अंत में, Preposition 'by' जोड़ा जाएगा।

questions.solution:

Key Points

  • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
  • Here, 'Provided' should be used instead of 'Unless'.
  • It means 'only if; on condition that'. (यदि; इस शर्त पर कि, बशर्ते कि)
    • Example: She agreed to go and work abroad provided (that) her family could go with her.
  • Whereas, 'unless' means 'if... not; except if'. (यदि... नहीं; तब तक नहीं जब तक)
    • Example: I was told that unless my work improved, I would lose the job.
       

Correct Sentence: Provided you carry a Covid- 19 negative report, you can travel by air.
